svg.title: Bottleneck Migration Network
svg.desc: An external demand shock reaches three D0 roots at once: Serving Plane, Data Center, and Delivery Network. Depth and bottleneck state are independent; purple dashed paths are substitute routes not yet adopted.
svg.text: External demand hits three D0 roots at once; effective capacity is limited by the narrowest of Serving Plane, Data Center, and Delivery Network.
traffic delivery outside the data center

text.tspan: Shared with GPU and SSD Controller
Rotor Forging · Boiler Tube · High-pressure Valve
Foundry Capacity Shared with Optical DSP
Tools Shared with GPU and HBM
Capacity Shared by Cloud · CDN · Carrier

svg.text: Depth is the shortest dependency distance from any D0 root; fill encodes node role or state, while purple dashed borders encode substitute routes.
The three D0 roots are an AND relation; no extra “service capacity” node is required.
D0 does not mean red. Red may appear at D2, D3, or D4. Bottleneck Migration moves the binding state, not the node's Depth.
